review_result.summary: The code is well-structured and readable, but there are some issues with performance, security, and best practices.

issues.description: The CSS styles are not separated from the HTML code. It's better to put them in a separate file for easier maintenance.
issues.suggestion: Create a separate CSS file and link it to the HTML file.

issues.description: The code uses localStorage to store the high score, which can be vulnerable to XSS attacks. It's better to use a more secure storage solution.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a backend API to store the high score or use a more secure client-side storage solution like IndexedDB.

issues.description: The game does not handle the case where the snake runs into the food and the new food is generated at the same position as the snake's head. This can cause the snake to eat the food multiple times.
issues.suggestion: Add a check to ensure that the new food is not generated at the same position as the snake's head.

issues.description: The game uses a fixed interval to update the game state, which can cause performance issues if the game is running on a slow device. It's better to use a more adaptive timing solution.
issues.suggestion: Consider using requestAnimationFrame to update the game state, which can provide a more adaptive timing solution.
